title: We Recommend Brave Browser 🦁
items: For the best AniCult experience, we recommend using Brave Browser — some video providers may show pop-up ads on other browsers.
Brave blocks ads & trackers automatically, giving you a clean, faster and uninterrupted streaming experience.
You can continue with any browser, but Brave ensures zero ad interruptions on AniCult.
